sentences.text: Constellate computed that two adult-onset forms of neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis, called Kufs type 4 and Kufs type 6B, have very similar symptom profiles [e_ce354082026d].
The similarity score is 0.740 over 13 shared terms, and the top shared term is a build-up of fluorescent storage material inside cells [e_ce354082026d].
This link is inferred, meaning Constellate calculated it from symptom terms, and it is not a database finding [e_ce354082026d].
Curated databases tie the two forms to different genes, DNAJC5 for type 4 and CLN6 for type 6B [e_3ebe7264493c] [e_6dc087c1d0a1].
Type 4 has two observed symptoms recorded in OMIM, dementia and myoclonic seizures, both from a single report with a frequency of 1 of 1 [e_44d0b28f5807] [e_b240bc0219e5].
So similar symptoms here come with different causes, according to these edges [e_ce354082026d] [e_3ebe7264493c] [e_6dc087c1d0a1].
These edges say nothing about the symptoms of type 6B beyond the computed score, and they show no studies, treatments or contradicting evidence [e_ce354082026d].
